_source.description: Active and historic launch sites worldwide
_source.origin: FAA/AST licensed launch site data (faa.gov/space), ESA launch facility profiles, and Jonathan McDowell's launch site database (planet4589.org).
_source.license: FAA: public domain; McDowell: public reference
_source.notes: Coordinates from FAA site licenses and published facility coordinates.

active.name: Kennedy Space Center LC-39A
active.notes: Primary SpaceX Falcon 9/Heavy & Starship launch pad; historic Apollo/Shuttle pad

active.name: Cape Canaveral SLC-40
active.notes: High-tempo Falcon 9 pad, 40+ launches/year

active.name: Cape Canaveral SLC-41
active.notes: Atlas V and Vulcan Centaur launch complex

active.name: Vandenberg SLC-4E
active.notes: Polar orbit Falcon 9 launches, West Coast

active.name: SpaceX Starbase (Boca Chica)
active.notes: Starship development & launch facility; world's largest rocket

active.name: Wallops Flight Facility
active.notes: Antares/Cygnus ISS resupply; Electron launches

active.name: Baikonur Cosmodrome
active.notes: World's first spaceport; Soyuz, Proton launches; leased from Kazakhstan

active.name: Vostochny Cosmodrome
active.notes: Russia's newest spaceport in Amur Oblast; Soyuz-2 launches

active.name: Plesetsk Cosmodrome
active.notes: Primary Russian military launch site; most launches in history

active.name: Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center
active.notes: China's oldest launch site; crewed Shenzhou missions

active.name: Xichang Satellite Launch Center
active.notes: BeiDou navigation constellation; geostationary launches

active.name: Wenchang Space Launch Site
active.notes: China's newest & most equatorial site; Long March 5/7; Tiangong modules

active.name: Satish Dhawan Space Centre (Sriharikota)
active.notes: India's primary spaceport; PSLV, GSLV, LVM3 launches; Chandrayaan missions

active.name: Guiana Space Centre (Kourou)
active.notes: European spaceport; Ariane 6, Vega-C; near-equatorial advantage

active.name: Tanegashima Space Center
active.notes: Japan's primary launch site; H-IIA/H3 rockets

active.name: Uchinoura Space Center
active.notes: Solid-fuel rocket launches; Epsilon vehicle

active.name: Naro Space Center
active.notes: South Korea's only spaceport; Nuri (KSLV-II) orbital launches

active.name: Semnan Space Center
active.notes: Iran's primary launch facility; Simorgh & Qased vehicles

active.name: Palmachim Airbase
active.notes: Shavit launches westward (retrograde orbit) over Mediterranean

active.name: Rocket Lab LC-1 (Mahia)
active.notes: World's first private orbital launch complex; Electron vehicle

active.name: Alcântara Launch Center
active.notes: Most equatorial launch site in the world; VLS program

active.name: Esrange Space Center
active.notes: Suborbital rockets & high-altitude balloons; planned orbital launches

active.name: SaxaVord Spaceport
active.notes: UK's first vertical launch site; Unst, Shetland Islands

active.name: Arnhem Space Centre
active.notes: Australia's first commercial orbital launch site; NASA sounding rockets

historic.name: Edwards AFB / Dryden (X-15 Program)
historic.notes: X-15 and Space Shuttle landing site; first supersonic flight

historic.name: White Sands Missile Range
historic.notes: V-2 tests, first US rocket launches; Trinity nuclear test site nearby

historic.name: Kapustin Yar
historic.notes: Soviet Union's first rocket launch site (1947); R-1 tests

historic.name: Woomera Test Range
historic.notes: British rocket tests; Black Arrow, Europa launches (1960s)

historic.name: San Marco Platform
historic.notes: Offshore equatorial launch platform; Scout rockets (1964-1988)
